source.attribution: Facsimile by Kyra van der Moezel; AKU-PAL (Akademie der Wissenschaften und der Literatur Mainz), AKU Hieratogramm 6504

notes: AKU-PAL Hieratogramm (HT) 6504; AKU grapheme L0030 (AKU GR 338). Gold = the grapheme's MdC code(s) as given by AKU-PAL: L2 (std). Möller numbers listed by AKU-PAL for this grapheme: 260. Source publication of this facsimile: Möller 1927a, p. 25, no. 260. Occurrence: find place Elephantine; writing direction "Kolumnen, linksläufig prograd"; ink colour "schwarz"; sign size 12.5 x 18.5 mm (h x w). AKU dating: "Altes Reich, 6. Dynastie". Facsimile type: Digitalisat (AKU), by Kyra van der Moezel. Rendered from the source SVG facsimile to PNG at 20 px/mm (long edge clamped to 160-600 px) on a white background with a white margin.
